bgm.name: ORAS Dungeon - Petalburg Woods (Petalburg Woods) (Petalburg Woods) (Petalburg Woods)

parameters: \bWhat, are you coming?\nCome and get some, then!

parameters.name: ORAS Battle Intro - Team Aqua Grunt (Team Aqua Appears!)

parameters: \bThat hostage POKéMON turned out to\nbe worthless!
\bAnd to think I made a getaway…\nIn this tunnel to nowhere!
\bHey! You!\nSo you want to battle me?
\bThe Boss told me this would be a\nslick-and-easy job to pull.
\bAll I had to do was steal some package\nfrom Devon.
\bTch!\nYou want it back that badly, take it!
\bPeeko!\nAm I glad to see you're safe!
\bThey call me Mr. Briney.\nAnd, you are?
\bAh, so you are \PN!\nI sincerely thank you!
\bNow, if there's anything that troubles\nyou, don't hesitate to tell me!
\bYou can usually find me in my cottage\nby the sea near Petalburg Woods.
\bCome, Peeko, we should make our way\nhome.
